title: Attabad Lake
credits: Photos: Umar Farooq, Hasan Shaukat / Unsplash
lines: This is Attabad Lake, in Hunza.
It did not exist before twenty ten.
That January, a massive landslide blocked the Hunza River, burying villages and flooding part of the Karakoram Highway.
The water that piled up behind it became this turquoise lake.
Born from a disaster, it is now one of Gilgit-Baltistan's most visited sights.
